claims.text: A 3:1 LTV-to-CPA ratio is a widely used benchmark in growth marketing for judging whether acquisition spend is sustainable.
A low LTV:CPA ratio can stem from either expensive leads or slow follow-up, and the ratio alone doesn't reveal which cause is responsible.
Some missed-call text-back systems trigger only after the full voicemail cycle completes rather than the moment the call is missed
A typical greeting-plus-prompt cycle can burn roughly 20-30 seconds before the text sends
An outside caller timing the text arrival is a valid, logically sound way to test this
